title: Tipping and PPV Payment Flow
purpose: Fan tips creator or unlocks PPV content via crypto payments through the PoDMPaymentProtocol smart contract, with frontend wallet interaction, on-chain verification, and content unlock
description: Two parallel crypto payment flows: (1) Tipping — fan calls payTip(creatorWallet, amount, metadata) in wallet, smart contract signs and broadcasts, txHash returned, frontend POSTs to /api/v1/payments/crypto/verify, backend verifies on-chain and records transaction; (2) PPV Unlock — fan calls payPPV(contentId, creatorWallet, amount), after verification backend additionally calls contentService.unlockContentForFan to insert or update unlock record, granting access. Both flows use the same verifyAndRecordBasePayment pipeline. Frontend calls dead Stripe endpoints (/payments/tip, /unlock-post) that return 404. Wallet interaction is mocked in current frontend (useCryptoWallet hook returns fake txHash).

preconditions: Fan is authenticated with valid JWT
Fan has connected crypto wallet (MetaMask or embedded)
Fan has approved USDC spend via USDC.approve(contractAddress, amount)
Content exists and is PPV-gated (for PPV flow)
postconditions: Tip: Transaction record created in DB with type=Tip, status=Cleared
PPV: Transaction record created + content.unlock record inserted/updated for fanId+contentId
Fan receives confirmation and (for PPV) access to content

validationRules.rule: paymentType must be one of: Tip, PPV Post, PPV Message, Subscription
For PPV: contentId must exist and be PPV-gated
Duplicate txHash prevented by unique constraint on blockchain_tx_hash

businessRules.rule: Platform fee 12.5% applied to both tips and PPV payments
PPV unlock requires both verified transaction AND contentService unlock record
Frontend calls dead Stripe endpoints that return 404 — code is dead but not removed
Wallet hook is fully mocked in development — returns hardcoded addresses and fake txHash

securityConsiderations: Sandbox bypass (0x0000 txHash) applies to both tip and PPV flows — any authenticated user can create fake transactions
Frontend uses raw fetch() for crypto verify, bypassing apiClient auth interceptors
Dead Stripe endpoints still exposed — no authentication on 404 responses
Wallet mock means PPV 'unlock' works without real payment in current implementation
performanceConsiderations: Blockchain RPC call adds 2-10 seconds to both tip and PPV flows
PPV flow has additional content unlock DB write after verification
No caching — each payment verification is fresh

annotations.text: Frontend calls dead Stripe endpoints (POST /api/v1/payments/tip and /unlock-post) that return 404 — leftover dead code
Wallet interaction in useCryptoWallet.ts is fully mocked — returns fake hardcoded txHash without real MetaMask interaction
Sandbox bypass: 0x0000-prefixed txHash skips all on-chain verification for both tip and PPV
PPV flow adds content unlock step after successful verification — tip flow only records transaction
